name: Ranked grind
text: Grinding ranked matches late at night: locked in, focused, competitive and steady. Want music that keeps concentration high without distracting, driving and rhythmic. People say: climbing rank, grinding, queueing up, ranked ladder, focused session.

name: Pre-drop hype
text: Hyping up before dropping into a hot zone and the first fight. Adrenaline, pumped up, aggressive, fired up, ready to go. Loud and fast. People say: hyped, pumped, drop in, drop zone, before the match, warm up.

name: Winding down after a win
text: Relaxing and celebrating after winning a match, a champion. Calm, content, satisfied and mellow, cooling off and enjoying the moment.

name: Tilted after a loss
text: Frustrated, tilted and angry after a bad loss or getting third-partied. Venting, annoyed, mad. Needs something heavy to let the anger out, or something calm to reset. People say: I lost, losing, lose streak, tilt, tilted, salty, rage, raging, so mad.

name: Studying or homework
text: Studying, reading, doing homework or coding. Needs quiet, unobtrusive, calm and focused background music with little vocal distraction.

name: Sad and reflective
text: Feeling sad, lonely, heartbroken, reflective or nostalgic. Wants emotional, slow, melancholic songs to sit with the feeling.

name: Workout
text: Working out at the gym, running or lifting. Needs powerful, pumping, high tempo, motivating, energetic songs.

name: Road trip
text: Driving with friends on a road trip, windows down. Sing-along, carefree, happy, warm, nostalgic and upbeat.
